profile: isolated temporary user-data directory; no default user profile used
fixture: loopback HTTP page at 127.0.0.1:9844 with title History QA Page

steps.action: Navigate to the loopback fixture with a unique query string
steps.expected: The visit is stored in browser-data.json with the page title, URL, and timestamp

steps.action: Open History from the start page History button through the browser IPC surface
steps.expected: History window shows the recorded page
The matching page remains and a nonmatching query shows No matching history

steps.action: Open the entry in a new tab
steps.expected: The browser has two tabs and navigates to the stored URL

steps.action: Remove one entry and clear all history
steps.expected: The list updates immediately and the empty state is shown

steps.action: Restart the packaged app with the same isolated profile
steps.expected: The saved visit remains in History; restoring its open tab does not add a phantom visit

steps.action: Emulate light and dark color schemes and inspect the browser chrome computed styles
steps.expected: White/gray light chrome and charcoal dark chrome with a visibly lifted active tab

limitations: The Mac screen was locked, so the test used Chromium DevTools Protocol against the packaged renderer rather than physical keyboard or Orca interaction.
The fixture was loopback-only and this scenario does not validate public-network navigation or sync behavior.
